 .

The learned Assistant Government Pleader
respondent No.2
seeks time to file affidavit in reply.

2. Prima facie, it is seen that the entire proceedings with regard to determining of the amount of compensation under the Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has taken place at the Authority at Nagpur.

entities.text:
Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The said proceedings have now been transferred to Aurangabad.
It is informed that two proceedings are now scheduled on 22.06.2023 at Circuit Bench at Pune.

3. The learned Counsel for the petitioner/tenant as well as the learned Counsel for the land owners who intend to intervene in the present proceedings submit that the written notes of arguments were placed on record before the Authority and only the final order was to be passed.
